heading: Sell our brands
intro: We work with music stores, online shops, installers and studios across Lebanon. Approved resellers get:

benefits.title: Local stock
benefits.text: Order from our warehouse in Lebanon instead of importing yourself.

benefits.title: Reseller pricing
benefits.text: Trade prices with protected margins on every brand we carry.

benefits.title: Warranty handled here
benefits.text: Faulty units are repaired or replaced through us, in Lebanon.

benefits.title: Training and demo support
benefits.text: Product training for your staff and help with in-store demos.
